2935-on-the-study-of-zoology.title: On The Study Of Zoology
2935-on-the-study-of-zoology.creator: Thomas H. Huxley
2935-on-the-study-of-zoology.description: A book by Thomas H. Huxley. found convenient (and indeed necessary) to associate the sciences which deal with vitality and all its phenomena under the common head of "biology"; and the biologists have come to repudiate any blood-relationship with their foster-brothers, the mineralogists.

arxiv-2012-06963.title: The Arithmetic Fourier Transform
arxiv-2012-06963.creator: Joel L. Schiff
arxiv-2012-06963.description: Abstract ABSTRACT. The Arithmetic Fourier Transform is a numerical formulation for computing Fourier series and Taylor series coefficients. It competes with the Fast Fourier Transform in terms of speed and efficiency, requiring only addition operations and can be performed by parallel processing.

arxiv-2207-10348.title: Ultra-low noise, bi-polar, programmable current sources
arxiv-2207-10348.creator: M. S. Mrozowski, I. C. Chalmers, S. J. Ingleby, P. F. Griffin, E. Riis
arxiv-2207-10348.description: Abstract We present the design process and implementation of fully open-source, ultra-low noise programmable current source systems in two configurations. Although originally designed as coil drivers for Optically Pumped Magnetometers (OPMs), the device specifications make them potentially useful in a range of applications.

arxiv-2308-07683.title: On the log motivic stable homotopy groups
arxiv-2308-07683.creator: Doosung Park
arxiv-2308-07683.description: Abstract . We compare the log motivic stable homotopy category and the usual motivic stable homotopy category over a perfect field admitting resolution of singularities. As a consequence, we show that the log motivic stable homotopy groups are isomorphic to the usual motivic stable homotopy groups. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14F42; Secondary 14A21 1.

arxiv-2405-16966.title: Dual-Delayed Asynchronous SGD for Arbitrarily Heterogeneous Data
arxiv-2405-16966.creator: Xiaolu Wang, Yuchang Sun ∗, Hoi-To Wai, Jun Zhang ∗
arxiv-2405-16966.description: Abstract We consider the distributed learning problem with data dispersed across multiple workers under the orchestration of a central server. Asynchronous Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) has been widely explored in such a setting to reduce the synchronization overhead associated with parallelization.

arxiv-2505-23835.title: “ Say What You Mean ”: Natural Language Access Control with Large Language Models for Internet of Things
arxiv-2505-23835.creator: Ye Cheng, Minghui Xu, Yue Zhang, Kun Li, Hao Wu, Yechao Zhang, Shaoyong Guo, Wangjie Qiu, Dongxiao Yu, Xiuzhen Cheng
arxiv-2505-23835.description: Abstract Access control in the Internet of Things (IoT) is becoming increasingly complex, as policies must account for dynamic and contextual factors such as time, location, user behavior, and environmental conditions. However, existing platforms either offer only coarse-grained controls or rely on rigid rule matching, making them ill-suited for semantically rich or ambiguous access scenarios.

pmc-10664511.title: Sustainable formulation polymers for home, beauty and personal care: challenges and opportunities
pmc-10664511.creator: Christina A. R. Picken, Orla Buensoz, Paul D. Price, Christopher Fidge, Laurie Points, Michael P. Shaver
pmc-10664511.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). As society moves towards a net-zero future, the need to adopt more sustainable polymers is well understood, and as well as plastics, less visible formulation polymers should also be included within this shift. As researchers, industries and consumers move towards more sustainable products there is a clear need to define what sustainability means in fast moving consumer goods and how it can be considered at the design stage.

pmc-10751512.title: Effects of probiotic supplementation on semen parameters after varicocelectomy: A randomized controlled trial
pmc-10751512.creator: Mousa Asadi, Farshad Gholipour, Amirhossein Rahavian, Mohammad Javanbakht
pmc-10751512.description: Background:The use of probiotics in the treatment of infertility is a new area of research. In this study, our objective was to examine the efficacy of probiotic supplementation on semen parameters following varicocelectomy.Materials and Methods:We included infertile men in our study who were the candidates for subinguinal microscopic varicocelectomy.

pmc-11354024.title: Machine Learning on Ultrasound Texture Analysis Data for Characterizing of Salivary Glandular Tumors: A Feasibility Study
pmc-11354024.creator: Li-Jen Liao, Ping-Chia Cheng, Feng-Tsan Chan, Emanuele David
pmc-11354024.description: Background: Objective quantitative texture characteristics may be helpful in salivary glandular tumor differential diagnosis. This study uses machine learning (ML) to explore and validate the performance of ultrasound (US) texture features in diagnosing salivary glandular tumors. Material and methods: 122 patients with salivary glandular tumors, including 71 benign and 51 malignant tumors, are enrolled.

pmc-11616689.title: Sunflower-like self-sustainable plant-wearable sensing probe
pmc-11616689.creator: Shuang Wang, Yangfan Chai, Huiwen Sa, Weikang Ye, Qian Wang, Yu Zou, Xuan Luo, Lijuan Xie, Xiangjiang Liu
pmc-11616689.description: Powering and communicating with wearable devices on bio-interfaces is challenging due to strict weight, size, and resource constraints. This study presents a sunflower-like plant-wearable sensing device that harnesses solar energy, achieving complete energy self-sustainability for long-term monitoring of plant sap flow, a crucial indicator of plant health.

pmc-12639461.title: A Label-Free blocking immunoassay to evaluate Anti-Adalimumab antibody activity in clinical samples
pmc-12639461.creator: Judi Abdelrazik, Naomi Iwai, Yonghua Liu, Nathaniel Taylor, Ruben Y Luo
pmc-12639461.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•A novel LF-BIA using BLI to quantify the blocking activity of ADAs against ADL.•The LF-BIA detected blocking activity of ADAs in serum samples.•The LF-BIA may complement the existing traditional assays for total ADAs.Keywords: Label-Free Blocking Immunoassay, Biolayer Interferometry, Adalimumab, Anti-Drug Antibodies

Introduction

Adalimumab (ADL) is a monoclonal antibody (mAb) drug against tumor necrosis factor-⍺ (TNF-⍺) for the treatment of autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, Crohn’s disease, psoriasis, and juvenile arthritis [1].

pmc-13222785.title: Case report: superficial kaposiform hemangioendothelioma without the Kasabach–Merritt phenomenon
pmc-13222785.creator: Yeli Chen, Ziyu Huang, Feifei Huang, Jianna Chen, Yazhou Wang
pmc-13222785.description: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) is a rare intermediate-grade malignant vascular tumor that is frequently associated with the Kasabach–Merritt phenomenon (KMP). Cases without KMP are less common and, therefore, prone to misdiagnosis. We report a case of superficial KHE in a 6-month-old male infant without associated KMP.

pmc-13270566.title: Dental professionals’ knowledge and awareness of teledentistry
pmc-13270566.creator: Abla Arafa, Nour AbdelShakoor, Amira Hegazy, Mohamed Salah, Malak Abdelazim, Ahmed Ezzat, Moustafa Moufeed, Mohamed Youssef, Clara Raymond, Fares Jamal
pmc-13270566.description: PurposeTo assess teledentistry (TD) knowledge and enhance its awareness among different categories of dental professionals, interns and dental students.MethodsThis cross-sectional survey used self-administered prevalidated pretested questionnaire (electronic version) that is divided into two sections; the first section focused on participants’ demographic data, and the second section assessed knowledge, attitude, practice perspectives, and perceived barriers towards TD.

pmc-13532576.title: Enhancing brain age estimation with structural MRI and synthesized cerebral blood volume maps
pmc-13532576.creator: Jordan Jomsky, Zongyu Li, Kay C Igwe, Yiren Zhang, Max Lashley, Tal Nuriel, Andrew Laine, Scott A Small, Jia Guo, Howard Rosen, Howard Rosen, Bradford C Dickerson, Kimoko Domoto-Reilly, David Knopman, Bradley F Boeve, Adam L Boxer, John Kornak, Bruce L Miller, William W Seeley, Maria-Luisa Gorno-Tem
pmc-13532576.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Brain age gap estimation (BrainAGE) is a promising imaging-derived biomarker of neurobiological ageing and disease risk, yet current approaches rely predominantly on T1-weighted structural MRI, overlooking functional vascular changes that may precede tissue damage and cognitive decline. Deep learning-derived cerebral blood volume (DeepCBV) maps, synthesized from non-contrast MRI, offer a scalable alternative to contrast-enhanced perfusion imaging by capturing vascular information relevant to early neurodegeneration.

pmc-13631802.title: Laryngeal Cancer Survival in Northern United Kingdom: A Multi‐Centre Retrospective Observational Study
pmc-13631802.creator: Amar Rajgor, Rhona Hurley, Catriona M. Douglas, Claire Paterson, James Moor, Shane Lester, Sara Sionis, Katherine Davies, James O’Hara, Gareth Inman, Terry Jones, David Winston Hamilton, Amarkumar Rajgor, Amarkumar Rajgor, Rhona Hurley, Catriona M. Douglas, Claire Paterson, James Moor, Shane Lester,
pmc-13631802.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesLaryngeal cancer incidence has risen globally, yet survival outcomes have shown limited improvement over recent decades. This study evaluated contemporary outcomes across multiple centres in Northern UK and examined stage‐ and treatment‐specific survival.DesignMulti‐centre retrospective observational study.Setting and ParticipantsData were collected for 2028 patients with biopsy‐proven squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx treated with curative intent between 2015 and 2021 across six tertiary head and neck cancer centres (Newcastle, Glasgow, Liverpool, Sheffield, Leeds, and Middlesbrough).Main Outcome MeasuresOverall survival (OS) and disease‐specific survival (DSS)
